topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Increasing array size amplifies insertion loss due to longer SIW transmission lines, impacting radiation efficiency. This leads to lower signal quality and increased interference, ultimately decreasing system throughput and reliability. Adaptive beamforming can mitigate these effects by dynamically adjusting antenna weights.
reference_context: SIW arrays face trade-offs between array size, gain, and radiation efficiency, with larger arrays experiencing higher insertion loss and reduced efficiency.
